description: Image Description: The image features a novelty cake designed to resemble a white porcelain toilet, placed on a black-and-white checkered surface that mimics a bathroom floor. The cake is highly detailed, with a closed tank and an open lid, revealing a blue fondant "water" inside the bowl. The toilet seat is slightly raised, and the lid is decorated with green icing text that reads "Andy 50 Today," indicating it is a celebratory cake for a 50th birthday.
